office_does: The district court judge hears misdemeanor criminal, traffic and smaller civil cases at Garfield County's one district court in Pomeroy.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Thomas W. Cox, first elected in 2018, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Garfield County District Court judge since winning the seat in 2018, running unopposed; he submitted no statement to the voters' guide.
highlights: Sits at the courthouse in Pomeroy [S2]
